messages:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV=1 — elevated inference error rate and 5xx spike from az1a. Impacting hosted and some dedicated pools. Metrics: https://grafana.redwood/az1a-egress (auto-attached)
prateek: taking this. seeing conn resets on the gRPC pool and high tx queue length on hosts in az1a.
maria: confirmed, kernel tx_queue rising to 250k on multiple instances, CPU fine, NIC tx drops increasing.
dmitri: any sign of resolver timeouts or NLB health flip?
samir: NLB target health shows intermittent 502s and backend drain flags for some ephemerals. resolver latency also high (p95 ~1200ms).
prateek: probable egress/backplane saturation on az1a. immediate mitigation: reduce routed traffic to az1a and shift inference flows to eu-west1a and us-west2a.
dmitri: +1. start policy-based steering, lower weight for az1a pools, enable fallback model variant where applicable.
prateek: running reroute now:
```bash
# reduce weight for az1a inference pool
redwood route update --pool az1a --weight 0.15 --policy gradual --reason "egress queue saturation"
# bump eu-west1a/us-west2a weights
redwood route update --pool eu-west1a --weight 0.6
redwood route update --pool us-west2a --weight 0.25
```
maria: applying KV-cache warmup on target regions so latency doesn't spike. kicked cache-populate job for top 100 models.
prateek: traffic steering in progress — watch for error rate regression and customer impacts.
prateek: immediate customer callouts: AcmeAnalytics and NovaChat showing 10-20% increased 5xx. posting SOC alert.
samir: also seeing increased retransmits between az1a hosts and resolver; looks like transient host egress queue clamp.
dmitri: ONCALL: @oncall-shift please take post-mitigation watch and coordinate any customer comms. I'll stay until handoff.
oncall-shift: I'm on deck. confirm final routing change and I'll open incident timeline + bridge.
prateek: final route changes applied at 3467990045. error rate dropped 30% in 60s but still above baseline.
maria: cache warmup mostly done for heavy models, tail latencies improving.
eve: jumping in for handoff, checking logs and beginning targeted instance drains in az1a (evict ephemerals with highest tx drops).
dmitri: good. action items: 1) continue steering 2) drain worst hosts in az1a 3) watch customer 5xx and Uptime SLAs 4) prepare follow-up postmortem.
oncall-shift: posted incident bridge (https://meet.redwood/incident/3467990001) and created #inc-3467990001 for comms. tagged SRE, support, and product.
samir: after partial drain, tx_queue on drained hosts fell to normal, NLB errors decreased. still watching resolver p95.
eve: starting longer-term remediation checklist: investigate NIC driver telemetry, kernel qdisc settings, and cloud host egress quotas. scheduling deep-dive tomorrow.
prateek: leaving in eve's hands at 3467990110. oncall-shift taking 1hr handoff to monitor.
oncall-shift: acknowledged. will escalate to infra if error rate doesn't return to baseline by 10m. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident annotated: mitigations applied (traffic steer, host drains, cache warmup). severity remains 1 — monitoring.
